label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: param from request.getParameter flows directly into SQL table name concatenation. Regex ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$ validates character set but does not whitelist specific allowed tables - attacker can supply any valid alphanumeric table name. Resolved sink value = user-controlled param containing attacker input. No prepared statement usage. Dynamic table name with user input is vulnerable despite character restriction.

evidence.note: User input param flows to SQL table name without prepared statement
